original_test_intent: Prove that the physical SMA-to-BMC SMBus path mapped as BMC I2C-1 supports an end-to-end SSIF management transaction with the correct slave endpoint, framing, completion status and payload, not merely that some address acknowledges.
original_method: Bind logical I2C-1 to the exact BMC controller/adapter/mux/channel and SMA connector; identify SMA SSIF slave address, SMBus speed/PEC expectations and vendor-supported read-only IPMI/SSIF request including netfn, command, response length/data and completion code; have an operator inspect/photograph the cable/connector; preserve BMC/SMBus baseline; issue only the approved protocol transaction through the supported BMC stack or vendor utility; capture request and response plus driver/bus errors and prove repeatable functional communication without raw writes or unsafe scans.
manual_activity: An operator verifies and photographs the SMA-to-BMC SSIF connector/cable under the vendor service procedure; the owner supplies the supported protocol transaction and owns bus recovery.
required_inputs: Logical I2C-1 to BMC controller/adapter/mux/channel/SMA connector map and SSIF slave identity
Approved SMBus/SSIF speed, PEC/framing and supported BMC driver/vendor-tool path
Read-only IPMI SSIF request netfn/command/payload and expected response/completion/data/timing oracle
Physical inspection procedure, bus/driver error tolerance, timeout/abort and vendor recovery
safety_requirements: Use the supported BMC SSIF stack or explicitly approved vendor transaction, not arbitrary raw SMBus writes
Do not infer function from an address ACK or scan unknown devices/registers
Preserve BMC, SSIF driver and bus error logs; avoid disrupting the live management path
Stop on malformed/incorrect response, timeout, PEC/framing error, stuck bus, arbitration storm or BMC/SMA instability
No automatic retransmission/reset/retry beyond the protocol's approved behavior
agent_execution_scope: Validate physical/path identity, SSIF endpoint, protocol request/response oracle and safe tool
After operator confirmation, execute only the approved non-destructive SSIF transaction and capture complete protocol evidence
Correlate completion/payload with SSIF driver and SMBus health
Do not use generic i2cdetect as functional proof, invent an IPMI command, write arbitrary data, reset bus/BMC or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve I2C-1 controller/mux/SMA path, SSIF address and physical connector
Approve the exact supported SSIF transaction, expected framing/completion/payload/timing, error tolerance and recovery
Review physical and protocol evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: i2cdetect/i2cget may assist identity checks only; they do not exercise SSIF request/response framing or validate IPMI completion and therefore cannot satisfy the functional criterion.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the approved BMC SSIF driver or vendor utility to issue the pinned read-only IPMI/SSIF request to the mapped SMA endpoint and preserve the full request, completion, payload, timing and SMBus error evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC I2C-1 SMA SSIF functional scope, AI_VR_I2C_bus1 bundle, and 10/10-minute allocation remain; no slave address or protocol command is invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: MEDIUM END_TO_END BMC SMA SSIF PROTOCOL FUNCTIONAL CHECK
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Require both operator-confirmed physical connectivity and a target-bound, vendor-supported SSIF transaction whose framing, completion code, payload and bus health match a predefined oracle.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact management topology, protocol-level acceptance, safe tool path, physical evidence and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An ACK or identity register can succeed while the SSIF driver, multipart framing, PEC, IPMI command handling or response path is broken.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Raw SMBus transactions can confuse a live SSIF endpoint or collide with the BMC management stack; protocol retries can hide intermittent errors if not bounded and logged.

project_override_considerations: A vendor SMA management utility may substitute only when it demonstrably uses the same SSIF path and returns request/response evidence. Generic I2C presence, host-side probing or unrelated IPMI transport does not cover BMC I2C-1 SSIF.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and operator SMA-to-BMC connector photos
BMC controller/adapter/mux/channel/SMA connector plus SSIF slave identity and bus settings
Exact approved tool/driver and request netfn/command/payload with timestamps
Complete SSIF response framing, completion code, payload, timing and PEC/multipart status
Pre/post BMC SSIF-driver and SMBus timeout/NACK/PEC/arbitration/stuck-bus evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure, Criteria and bundle consistently target the SMA-to-BMC SSIF link on I2C-1. The missing protocol transaction is an execution specification, not a competing objective.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The SSIF functional purpose is clear. Path map, endpoint, approved transaction and physical evidence are supplyable prerequisites, so static review is not irreducibly blocked.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2159 Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00046-V002: approve the logical BMC I2C-1 to controller/adapter/mux/channel/SMA connector map, SSIF slave address and bus/PEC settings, vendor-supported BMC SSIF stack/tool, exact read-only IPMI request netfn/command/payload with expected framing/completion/data/timing, physical photo procedure, error limits, aborts, and recovery.

review_improvement: Elevates the check from ambiguous bus presence to an end-to-end SSIF management exchange while keeping arbitrary writes and unsafe probing off the live BMC bus.
independent_technical_reasoning: SSIF is a protocol carried over SMBus, so electrical ACK proves only the lowest layer. Functional coverage requires a correctly framed management request, expected completion code and payload through the actual BMC SSIF stack. This distinction is critical because raw tools can bypass or conflict with the driver that the test intends to validate. The physical connector and protocol exchange are independent evidence layers and both are required.
